categories.explication: A deactivated category is no longer offered, but services and listings using it keep it. For items, the displayed name comes from the translation files when it exists; otherwise it is the name entered here.

impact.explication: Factor used to estimate the CO2 saved in professionals' statistics (kg CO2e saved per kg reused). Always give the source.

conteneurs.alerte_depot_en_cours: Warning: a drop-off is in progress in this box. Only force the status in case of an incident.
conteneurs.explication: A box holds only one item at a time. Its status changes automatically: "Occupied" when the item is dropped off, "Empty" when a professional collects it. Put a box under maintenance if there is a problem: it will no longer accept drop-offs.
conteneurs.nouveau_site: Location of the new box (e.g. Paris 11e)

documents.aucun: No archived document matches these criteria.
documents.beneficiaire_obligatoire: Choose who the document is for.
documents.chercher_beneficiaire: Type a name or an email…

codes.explication: Codes sent once a drop-off is approved: the opening code lets the member open the container, the barcode lets the professional collect the item.
codes.rechercher: Search a code, an item, a person, a site…

documents.contenu_aide: One line per paragraph: parties, purpose, duration, amount, terms…
documents.explication: Every PDF generated by the platform (contracts, certificates, service sheets, administrative documents) is archived here as a copy and stays available.

finances.explication_commission: For item sales, UpcycleConnect only keeps its commission: {volume} worth of items were sold between members over the period.
finances.explication_parametres: A new rate only applies to future sales: each sale keeps the rate in force on the day it was paid. The premium price applies to new subscriptions.
finances.prix_premium: Premium subscription price (€15 to €30 per month)

langues.etape_1: Add the language with the “Add a language” button (two-letter code and name): it is created disabled.
langues.etape_2: Download the template, have it translated, then click "Import translation" on the language row. The file is checked: it must contain every text of the template.
langues.etape_3: Once the file shows "Available", activate the language: it is offered to all users.
langues.supprimee: {langue} language deleted ({nombre} user(s) switched back to French).
langues.supprimer_intro: The {langue} ({code}) language will be deleted completely:
langues.supprimer_irreversible: This cannot be undone: you will have to create the language again and re-import its translation.
langues.supprimer_ligne: it is removed from the list of languages and from the site's language selector;
langues.supprimer_utilisateurs: {nombre} user(s) who had chosen it switch back to French.
